# Bismi Boutique

> Bismi Boutique is a fashion boutique based at 28/1B, Langs Garden Road, Pudupet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600002, India. The website provides a catalogue-style introduction to women's fashion, ethnic wear, modest wear and children's clothing.

## Product categories
- Women's clothing and ethnic wear
- Three-piece sets
- Two-piece sets
- Kurtas
- Modest wear and shawls
- Girls' co-ord sets
- Boys' co-ord sets
- T-shirts and children's everyday clothing

## Customer guidance
Customers should contact the boutique to confirm current product names, stock, sizes, colours, prices, shipping terms and payment options. The online catalogue currently contains demonstration product data; it should not be treated as a live inventory or a guarantee of availability.
